name: 黛拉
src: 月银纪史诗/第十五歌_日冕之晨.md:240
who: Della, a human woodcutter and fire-keeper of the east gate of the Sun Crown's city, thirty years old and looking it: about 166 cm, sturdy and square-shouldered, with strong forearms and palms hardened by axe handles. Deep teal-blue hair in one long braid coiled on top of her head so sparks cannot catch it, light blue eyes that narrow when she looks at flame. A lean, narrow-chinned face with a faint old burn scar on her LEFT cheek (on the viewer's right when she faces us), from a fire when she was eight. Fair skin. A practical, steady, quietly proud air.
build: 166 cm, sturdy: broad shoulders, strong arms, a small bust, a firm waist and plain rounded hips.
palette: deep teal and light blue, scorched leather brown, ash grey, a little ember orange
casual: Her woodcutter's clothes: a coarse undyed wool short-sleeved tunic to the hip over brown linen trousers, a thick leather apron burned through with several small holes, hide boots wrapped with thongs; a short hand axe at her belt on the right side. She stands square with one hand resting on the axe haft.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed linen dress to the shins, a knitted grey shawl, soft hide shoes, the braid let down over one shoulder. She stands relaxed with her hands loosely folded in front.
battle: Ready to hold the gate: the scorched leather apron over a studded leather jerkin, leather bracers, the braid pinned under a plain iron cap. She holds the short axe low in her right hand, the left hand open at her side; a steady, narrowed-eyed look.
formal: For a feast day at the east gate: a clean deep teal wool dress with long sleeves and a plain collar, a brushed leather belt with the short axe hung at the side, the braid coiled and pinned with a plain bone pin. She stands upright, the hands folded in front.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the light blue eyes narrowed slightly as if looking at a flame, the mouth closed, a calm proud look. Warm firelight from one side on the teal braid and the old scar, cool dawn blue from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and chopped wood chips.

name: 嘉琳
src: 月银纪史诗/第十五歌_日冕之晨.md:297
who: Jarlin, a human old hunter of the southern grain plains, sixty-nine years old: about 168 cm, lean and long-legged, still straight-backed, a woman who can walk from village to village in a day. Short hair that was wheat-coloured, now mostly white with streaks of wheat gold, cut ragged by her own hunting knife, as it always was. Pale amber eyes like dried wheat straw. Her freckles have turned to age spots and her face is deeply lined, with a long nose. Fair skin. She stands with one foot slightly pointed on the toe, as if about to run. A blunt, free, unbowed air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's lean face of about sixty-nine, NOT young: pale amber eyes, calm and far-seeing, slightly narrowed; deep lines at the eyes, cheeks and either side of the mouth; age spots over the freckled nose; thin white-streaked brows; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 168 cm, lean and long-legged, thin but upright, strong sinewy arms.
palette: wheat gold and straw, white hair, worn hide brown, faded green
casual: Her hunter's clothes: an old short plains hunter's jerkin over a worn long-sleeved shirt and trousers, leg wraps and soft boots; a short bow of the grain plains slung across her back, its limbs twice replaced; a small cloth pouch of wheat grains at her belt. She stands with one foot pointed on its toe, a hand on the bow string.
private: At rest: a loose, long-sleeved undyed wool shirt over soft trousers, a knitted brown vest, soft hide shoes. She holds a small pinch of wheat grains in one hand, a quiet look.
battle: Ready to shoot: the old hunter's jerkin laced tight, leather bracer on the left forearm, a quiver at the waist. She holds the short bow drawn halfway with an arrow nocked, eyes narrowed at the distance; a calm, hard look.
formal: For a harvest feast: her best clean brown wool tunic and trousers, a wheat-gold sash, a small bunch of wheat ears pinned at the chest, the short bow slung over the shoulder. She stands straight with the hands folded in front.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale amber eyes looking far off past the viewer, a faint dry half-closed smile. Low gold evening light from one side catching the ragged white hair. Foreground blur: tall wheat ears swaying and floating chaff.

name: 莱奥
src: 月银纪史诗/第十五歌_日冕之晨.md:343
who: Leo, a human young knight of the royal house of the grassland kingdom, nineteen: about 178 cm, slender, long-legged with a horseman's strength, shoulders not yet fully filled out. Light chestnut short hair with one curl falling across the forehead, amber eyes (the colour of the royal house). A handsome, still boyish face with a faint stubble on the chin and a small tiger-tooth showing when he smiles. Fair skin. A bright, earnest, slightly shy air.
build: 178 cm, slender: long legs from the saddle, shoulders not yet broad.
palette: light chestnut and amber, steel silver, horse-mane black, a little cream
casual: His knight's kit: a light plate cuirass whose plates are branded with a running wind-maned horse, over a padded cloth tunic, leather leggings and riding boots; a short dagger at his left hip (on the viewer's right when he faces us). He holds a long lance upright at his side, its tassel of black horsehair. A bright, open smile.
private: Off duty: a loose cream linen shirt with the collar open, a brown wool vest, plain trousers and soft boots. He stands relaxed, one hand pushing the curl off his forehead.
battle: Ready to charge: a side-vented leather riding tunic with a light cuirass of boiled-leather plates each branded with a running wind-maned horse, guarding only the chest and forearms, leather leg guards, soft boots, a plain open helm of hardened leather held under his arm. The horsehair-tasselled lance is lowered forward in both hands, and the branded horses flicker faintly with wind-light; a firm, determined look.
formal: For the court of the grassland king: a short riding tunic with slit skirts in royal deep green, edged in silver, the running-horse badge on the chest, a short cloak over one shoulder, polished boots. He stands upright with one hand on his belt, a proud, slightly nervous smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the amber eyes looking straight at the viewer, a small tiger-tooth showing in a bright smile. Golden morning sun from one side lighting the chestnut curl. Foreground blur: blades of tall grass and the horsehair tassel of a lance.
